request: Show learned moves, their types, effects and power, and explain the Pokemon talent

implementation.scope: Shared PokemonDetails team and read-only PC sheet in Adventure, Rift and Colosseum; no server/schema/player change
implementation.rootCause: Move list was only rendered when readOnly, excluding active party sheets
implementation.moves: Learned order, at most four; type colour, category, base power/fixed damage or variable/status label, accuracy, actual/max PP, French effect; no invented exact damage estimate
implementation.ability: Current passive ability description, existing unsupported/doubles-only notices retained
implementation.compatibility: Party abilities, PC moves/details, legacy case-insensitive names and unknown data; exhausted PP zero retained, transformed max PP five
implementation.preserved: Stats/IV/EV tabs, evolution and footer controls, focus return, stored held-item details; no mutation
implementation.runtime: Bundled local lookup, no requests per Pokemon; Map lookup cache
implementation.source: data/vendor/pokeapi/reference-texts.fr.json; revision 81d20919845b6a445969b9265aab5cec6b04cece; newest French text at version group <=18; hashes, per-entry group and BSD license retained
implementation.numbers: Current data/game/moves.json, independent of source text; overrides in data/game/pokemon_reference_overrides.fr.json
implementation.generator: npm run generate:reference; npm run generate:reference -- --check

unit.coverage: Catalog completeness and game numbers, generation bounds/staleness, zero PP, stored details, fixed/level/variable/status damage, transformed PP, unknowns/nonmutation, talent fallback and all type badge contrast >=4.5

checks: Party moves, real power, current/max PP including zero, French effects, type colour and talent; navigation updates both
Stored Pokemon uses same effect/talent descriptions; zero PP and read-only training/storage preserved, focus restored
Real Colosseum and multiplayer Rift use the same enriched sheet

limits: UI reference only; no change to battle mechanics
